responsibility: Declares the public interface and support macros for GCC’s statistics subsystem. Besides compile-time MEM_STAT argument macros tied to GATHER_STATISTICS, it exposes the initialization/finalization hooks and the two main recording APIs for scalar counter events and histogram events, providing the pass-facing contract for collecting optimization statistics while leaving storage and dump formatting to statistics.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declares the pass-facing statistics API and GATHER_STATISTICS/MEM_STAT support macros, whereas statistics.cc provides the actual per-pass counter storage, dump registration, and output logic.
